headline: Breaking! JCI Falls 1%, Here's the Cause
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index fell 1.04% to 5,092.68 at the start of trading. Market sentiment included the Indonesia-EU trade agreement.
why: The IHSG is Indonesia's main stock benchmark, tracking the country's largest listed companies. Its moves reflect local investor sentiment and foreign flows.
why_moved: The index opened lower amid market sentiment that includes the Indonesia-EU trade agreement, according to the report. The report does not give further detail on the cause.
